scope: February leap-day diagnostic only; no D2, full PCA, DTW, DIFI, classifier

parameters.night_time_interpretation: 00:30,01:30,02:30,03:30,23:30 in source; WDC HH:00 rows used provisionally
parameters.quiet_day_order: GFZ Q1-Q10; candidate 2 substitutes Q6 for Q5=29; candidate 3 uses Q1-Q4
parameters.daily_baseline: mean of the five selected night hours per day, subtracted before averaging days
parameters.missing_policy: No interpolation in Sq; selected IQD hours must all be finite; incomplete day excluded from calendar mapping score
parameters.calendar_score: Median constant offset between WDC complete-day 24h mean and Mendeley meanField; RMSE over remaining complete days
parameters.shape_metric: Remove each 24-hour series mean solely to diagnose additive offset; not a replacement baseline
parameters.svd: 2008 February X only; V0,V1,V2,V3 × 28/29 days; no final centering choice

D1-PCA.handling: Use February days 1–28 for PCA matrices; exclude 29 February in leap years
D1-PCA.basis: 28 indexed per-year rows, exact 308 year-major combined meanField, and X/Z independent WDC calendar mapping

D1-IQD.handling_hypothesis: Keep official GFZ Q1–Q5, including 29 February 2016
D1-IQD.basis: 2016 X/Y/Z Sq curve shapes favor official Q5=29; absolute residual retains unexplained baseline offset and time convention awaits D2

limitations: WDC HH:00 versus source HH:30 not resolved (D2).
Published Sq columns have 24h mean near zero, whereas night-baseline candidates have night-hour mean zero; source calculation or export includes an unreported additive centering step.
Mendeley February Y meanField is byte-identical to Z meanField; Y excluded from calendar mapping vote.
WDC data may differ from data used by authors; no D2 comparison performed.
V0–V3 SVD results diagnose calendar only and do not choose preprocessing.
Potential source/protocol inconsistency (S7) in benchmark Sq baseline and duplicated Y/Z meanField requires review before later gates.
